tips.title: Get a local number today
tips.description: Banks and deliveries often need SMS codes. A prepaid SIM on Day 1 unblocks almost everything else.

tips.title: Apply for your TFN early
tips.description: Waiting can mean higher tax withholding on your first payslips.

tips.title: Remember: emergency is 000
tips.description: Australia does not use 911. Save 000 and your home address in your phone.

tips.title: Photograph everything at move-in
tips.description: Condition reports plus photos protect your bond when you leave.

tips.title: Ask about bulk billing
tips.description: Not every GP is free. Ask about fees when you book.

tips.title: Plan one weekend escape
tips.description: Once SIM, bank, and transport are sorted, book a simple day trip — Blue Mountains, Phillip Island, or Glenelg are easy first wins.

tips.title: Never pay bond to a personal chat
tips.description: Genuine bonds are lodged with a state authority. If someone on WhatsApp wants a transfer first, stop.

tips.title: Only use my.gov.au
tips.description: Lookalike sites steal codes. Type the address yourself and check it ends in .gov.au.

tips.title: Search PPSR before you buy a car
tips.description: Only ppsr.gov.au is the government register. Third-party VIN sites are optional extras.

tips.title: ImmiAccount is online.immi.gov.au
tips.description: Visa applications stay on the Home Affairs portal. Ignore WhatsApp agents who want your passport scan.

tips.title: Set up tolls before a hire car
tips.description: Unpaid motorway trips become extra fees. Use your state .gov.au toll page, then the operator named there.

tips.title: Call 000 first — then check ambulance bills
tips.description: The call is free. Who pays for the ride depends on your state. Read healthdirect.gov.au.
